a-write-asks-the-wallet-for-what-it-cost.text: A write asks the wallet for what it costs: touch list.
The only files the writer may change. A file outside this list needs the milestone owner's ruling first.

production.text: The terminal composition loses the floor call. The outlay module gains the pure judgement and the plan module the refusal. The entry and preview modules call them. The funding module's descriptions change, with no code change.

documentation.text: The node documentation states the wallet rule beside the outlay rule. The ownership page corrects the funding module's row.

tests.text: Rows in the outlay spec, and one new spec in the open datum suite, registered in its cabal file and main module. The hosted job is the open datum tests job. No workflow, flake or script changes.

not-touched-by-name.text: The session, receipt and fold files and the command header that other lanes are changing, the create and edges files, the describe and inspect files, the conformance directory, and the reject and reclaim files.

rulings-taken.text: The plan review approved the scope, the outcome class, the unused wallet argument, the open datum registrations and the script comments. After the first hosted run the desk ruled that the end-to-end row asserting the removed floor is replaced, that the faucet step stays in the empty-wallet refusal and that the devnet part joins the gate. Because the end-to-end suite cannot run the insert command, the replacement reads an unfunded wallet on the devnet and runs the shared judgement, with one dependency line in the registry cabal file; a devnet insert from an empty wallet is a follow-up.
